title: forgectl --output=json
description: One document per run, written to stdout. Identical in shape for check and apply; apply additionally populates 'actions'. No property in this document ever carries a configured or generated value (FR-054).

repository.description: owner/name, as derived from the remote URL.

profiles.description: Selected profile names, in the order given. Empty when none was selected, in which case only branch and protection checks are present.

actions.description: Present only for apply. The plan, in execution order, each entry carrying its result.

warnings.description: Non-fatal conditions also emitted on stderr, repeated here so a JSON consumer sees them without reading two streams.

domain.description: The --only/--skip domain this check belongs to. The tags check reports domain 'protection'.

expected.description: Set on fail. A state description, never a value.

actual.description: Set on fail. A state description, never a value. For a drifted variable this is the literal string 'differs', never the differing value.

reason.description: Set on skip. Why the check could not be evaluated.

fixable.description: Whether apply can resolve this. False for a default branch that is neither master nor main (FR-039).

pattern.description: Set on the tags check: the tag pattern evaluated.

generator.description: Set only for a generated variable.

expires_at.description: Set only for a generated variable with an active token.

rotate_in_days.description: Days until the rotation threshold is reached. Negative once it is past.

description.description: The line shown in the plan preview. Never carries a value.

status.description: 'planned' appears only when the run was cancelled at the prompt; 'skipped' when --only/--skip excluded the domain.

error.description: Set when status is failed. Never carries a value.
